title: Open the dashboard
description: The user signs in and the Reports dashboard loads.

title: Choose a date range
description: The user opens the date picker and selects the last 30 days.

title: Add a filter
description: The user clicks Add filter, picks Region, and selects EMEA.

title: Export the report
description: The user opens the Export menu and chooses CSV.

title: Schedule delivery
description: The user clicks Schedule, sets weekly on Monday, and saves.
